texts.zh:
鉴于来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的需求如雪花般飘来，我们的研究工作已经愈发重要了。我们的许多科学家都在与这种压力作斗争，但从中却迸发出天才的闪光和偶现的惊人突破。

其中最新的一项是来自[targeted_scientist.GetName]设计的预备在我们某个部门中进行一系列实验。唯一的问题是，在他们的每一项研究计划中都包含了对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的活体实验。
texts.en:
Our research efforts grow ever more important in light of the continuous stream of demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName]. Many of our scientists struggle with this pressure, but we see glimmers of genius and the occasional amazing breakthrough.

The latest of these might come from [targeted_scientist.GetName], who has designed a set of daring experiments for one of our departments to undertake. The only problem being that experiments on live [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are part of every single one of their proposals.

texts.zh:
我们收到了更多来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的指令，他们希望我们进一步提高研究产出。关于我们如何才能不辜负宗主的厚望我们进行了大量的演算，并且我们相信已经找到了调整自己进程以适应目标的方法。

然而要完全实现这一点，我们必须对我们的无人机和共享神经网络进行一系列实验。这必将带来很大的风险。
texts.en:
We have received yet more demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName], as they want us to improve our research output. Several calculations have been run to figure out how we could live up to our overlord's expectations, and we believe we have found a way to adjust our processes to enable us to do so.

To go through with it however, we would have to conduct several experiments on our drones and our shared neural network. There will be a significant risk involved.

label.zh: 我们将会赞助这些研究。
我们不能对此做出让步。
label.en: We cannot compromise our very self.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[Root.Capital.GetName]某个居住区划的报告。与[targeted_scientist.GetName]的住所有关。当地执法人员发现了几具[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的残骸——似乎是曾在现场进行的失败的可怕实验的一部分。

我们被告知，还没有人能追踪到[targeted_scientist.GetName]，他以某种方式避开了所有的传感器。
texts.en:
We have received a report from one of the residential districts on [Root.Capital.GetName], relating to the domicile of [targeted_scientist.GetName]. Local law enforcers found the remains of several [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - seemingly part of gruesome albeit failed experiments - at the site.

We are told no one has been able to track down [targeted_scientist.GetName], who is somehow eluding all sensors.

label.zh: 也许那是为了得到更好的结果。
label.en: Maybe it was for the better then.

texts.zh: 我们收到来自[subject_empire.GetName]的消息——据说他们开始对自己的物种进行危险实验，而实验结果往往是灾难性的。虽然我们当地的使者并没有明确要求我们介入，但他们显然在暗示我们。
texts.en: News has reached us from the [subject_empire.GetName] - they have allegedly begun serious experimentation on their own species, often with disastrous results. Though our local emissary is not explicitly calling for us to intervene, it is most certainly implied in their communication.

texts.zh: 我们收到来自[subject_empire.GetName]的消息——据说他们开始对自己的物种进行危险实验。尽管原因尚不清楚，除了可能对他们自身造成伤害之外，我们认为让他们继续下去不会有任何特别的风险。
texts.en: News has reached us that the [subject_empire.GetName] has begun serious experimentation on their own species, though it is unclear for what reason. We do not foresee any particular risk in letting them continue, aside from what harm they might cause themselves.

label.zh: 我们无权干涉他们的内部事务。
label.en: It is not for us to intervene in their internal affairs.

label.zh: 格式塔意识 · 和平主义
格式塔意识 · 唯心主义

texts.zh: 我们的宗主国派来的使者带来了明确的命令，要求结束最近在[Root.Capital.GetName]上开展的针对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的实验和测试。虽然没有说明任何具体的原因，但其意思是明确的。
texts.en: An emissary from our overlord has brought explicit orders to put an end to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] experiments and tests recently begun on [Root.Capital.GetName]. While the message did not state any particular reason as to why, it was unambiguous in its meaning.

texts.zh:
我们还没有收到来自我们的宗主国[overlord_empire.GetName]的任何消息。他们似乎意识到我们最近开始的研究，并选择不以任何方式进行干预。

按照我们的计划，我们需要弄清楚下一步我们将进行什么实验。一个设计风险越大，可能的危害越大，就越有可能给我们的帝国带来长远的利益。
texts.en:
While we have not received any communication from our overlord [overlord_empire.GetName], it seems they are aware of the research we have recently begun and have chosen not to intervene in any way.

Moving forward with our plans, we need to figure out what experiments we will undertake next. The more risky and possibly harmful a design, the more potential long-term benefits it might bring our empire.

label.zh: 我们将致力于进行适当的实验。
label.en: We will commit to proper experimentation.

texts.zh: 我们做了这么多实验，最终只有失败和失望的结果。非要说有什么意义的话，我们学会了未来如何避坑。
texts.en: Ultimately the many experiments we conducted resulted in nothing but failure and disappointment. If nothing else, we have learned what not to do in the future.

texts.zh: 我们的大多数实验最终都得到了回报，并带来了一些意想不到的收获。大多数测试对象甚至幸存下来，而且表现得很好。所以总的来说，实验算是相当成功。
texts.en: Most of our experiments ended up paying off in the end, and have led to some unexpected learnings. Most of the test subjects even survived and appear to be doing fine, so all in all it can be considered quite the success.

texts.zh: 虽然有人会说成本比预期的要高，但我们在许多实验中都取得了巨大成功。通过几个有趣和意想不到的结果，我们学到的比我们原先预测的还要多。
texts.en: Though some would say the cost was higher than anticipated, we have met with unbridled success in our many experiments. With several interesting and unexpected results, we have learned more than any of our projections indicated.

texts.zh: 我们的许多实验导致我们的测试对象发生了一些有趣的变化，其形体或性格，从怪异可怕到微不足道的变化都有发生。出乎意料的是，这些变异从实验室逃逸，开始影响我们帝国的其他地区。
texts.en: Our many experiments led to some interesting mutations in our test subjects, ranging from the grotesque and horrific to limited changes in their physique or personality. What came as an unexpected surprise was these changes propagating beyond our labs, starting to affect the rest of our empire.

texts.zh: 我们做了这么多实验，最终只有失败和失望的结果。非要说有什么意义的话，我们学会了未来如何避坑。
texts.en: Ultimately the many experiments we conducted resulted in nothing but failure and disappointment. If nothing else, we have learned what not to do in the future.
